= e;\n      e = (d + temp1) >>> 0;\n      d = c;\n      c = b;\n      b = a;\n      a = (temp1 + temp2) >>> 0;\n    }\n\n    h0 = (h0 + a) >>> 0;\n    h1 = (h1 + b) >>> 0;\n    h2 = (h2 + c) >>> 0;\n    h3 = (h3 + d) >>> 0;\n    h4 = (h4 + e) >>> 0;\n    h5 = (h5 + f) >>> 0;\n    h6 = (h6 + g) >>> 0;\n    h7 = (h7 + h) >>> 0;\n  }\n\n  const hex = [h0, h1, h2, h3, h4, h5, h6, h7]\n    .map((v) => (v >>> 0).toString(16).padStart(8, \"0\"))\n    .join(\"\");\n  return `sha256:${hex}`;\n}\n\nconst FLOAT_FIELDS = new Set([\n  \"cash\", \"coordination\", \"correctionUptake\", \"load\", \"reading\",\n  \"reputation\", \"safetyThreshold\", \"satisfaction\", \"waitTime\", \"waste\",\n]);\n\nfunction serializeJson(value: unknown, pretty: boolean, sortKeys: boolean, level = 0, key?: string): string | undefined {\n  if (value === undefined) return undefined;\n  if (value === null || typeof value === \"boolean\" || typeof value === \"string\") return JSON.stringify(value);\n  if (typeof value === \"number\") {\n    if (!Number.isFinite(value)) throw new TypeError(\"canonical JSON does not support non-finite numbers\");\n    return FLOAT_FIELDS.has(key ?? \"\") && Number.isInteger(value) ? `${value}.0` : JSON.stringify(value);\n  }\n  if (Array.isArray(value)) {\n    const items = value.map((item) => serializeJson(item, pretty, sortKeys, level + 1));\n    return pretty && items.length > 0\n      ? `[\\n${items.map((item) => `${\"  \".repeat(level + 1)}${item ?? \"null\"}`).join(\",\\n\")}\\n${\"  \".repeat(level)}]`\n      : `[${items.map((item) => item ?? \"null\").join(\",\")}]`;\n  }\n  if (typeof value === \"object\") {\n    const record = value as Record<string, unknown>;\n    const keys = Object.keys(record);\n    if (sortKeys) keys.sort();\n    const entries = keys.flatMap((entryKey) => {\n      const serialized = serializeJson(record[entryKey], pretty, sortKeys, level + 1, entryKey);\n      return serialized === undefined ? [] : [[entryKey, serialized] as const];\n    });\n    return pretty && entries.length > 0\n      ? `{\\n${entries.map(([entryKey, serialized]) => `${\"  \".repeat(level + 1)}${JSON.stringify(entryKey)}: ${serialized}`).join(\",\\n\")}\\n${\"  \".repeat(level)}}`\n      : `{${entries.map(([entryKey, serialized]) => `${JSON.stringify(entryKey)}:${serialized}`).join(\",\")}}`;\n  }\n  throw new TypeError(`Unsupported JSON value: ${typeof value}`);\n}\n\n/** Backend-compatible JSON: sorted keys and decimal spelling for float fields. */\nexport function canonicalJson(value: unknown): string {\n  return serializeJson(value, false, true) ?? \"null\";\n}\n\n/**\n * Readable JSON that still spells float fields with a decimal point, so an\n * exported document round-trips through a typed backend reader unchanged. Keys\n * stay in declaration order — this is for humans and diffs, not for hashing.\n */\nexport function prettyJson(value: unknown): string {\n  return serializeJson(value, true, false) ?? \"null\";\n}\n\nexport function computeStateHash(data: unknown): string {\n  const json = typeof data === \"string\" ? data : canonicalJson(data);\n  return sha256Bytes(new TextEncoder().encode(json));\n}\n\n// ── Capture ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────\n\n/** One simulation tick of wall clock, matching the engine's own event stamping. */\nconst TICK_MS = 3000;\n\nexport const TRACE_RUN_KINDS = [\"live\", \"synthetic\", \"benchmark\"] as const;\nexport type TraceRunKind = (typeof TRACE_RUN_KINDS)[number];\n\nexport interface TraceCaptureOptions {\n  /** Defaults to `<variation>-<seed>`: the scenario, which repeats across runs. */\n  episodeId?: string;\n  /** The one run this trace came from. Omitted from the record when absent. */\n  sessionId?: string;\n  /** Required: live gameplay, synthetic episodes and benchmark episodes must stay distinguishable. */\n  runKind: TraceRunKind;\n  envVersion?: string;\n  /**\n   * Wall clock for tick 0. Given, the run's own recorded events are re-stamped\n   * from it (`startTime + tick * 3000ms`, the engine's rule) so a captured\n   * trace is byte-reproducible — which is what lets the benchmark fixture be\n   * diffed against a fresh capture at all.\n   */\n  startTime?: string;\n  deletion?: Partial<TraceV3Deletion>;\n  /** Omit to capture the run's own recorded event journal; pass to replace it wholesale. */\n  events?: TraceV3Event[];\n  /**\n   * Events the caller wants merged into the captured journal alongside the\n   * game's own recorded events (e.g. an out-of-band player note). Each is\n   * stamped with the `round` its `tick` falls in via `roundForTick`, and the\n   * merged journal stays ordered by tick.\n   */\n  additionalEvents?: TraceV3Event[];\n}\n\n/**\n * Turn a running game into a complete restaurant-arena-trace-v3 record.\n *\n * The instance method `game.captureTrace(options)` delegates here; both are\n * supported entry points because the overlay calls this standalone form.\n */\nexport function captureArenaTrace(game: RestaurantGame, options: TraceCaptureOptions): RestaurantArenaTraceV3 {\n  if (!options || !TRACE_RUN_KINDS.includes(options.runKind)) {\n    throw new TypeError(`captureArenaTrace: runKind must be one of ${TRACE_RUN_KINDS.join(\", \")}`);\n  }\n  const startMs = options.startTime === undefined ? undefined : Date.parse(options.startTime);\n  if (startMs !== undefined && Number.isNaN(startMs)) {\n    throw new TypeError(`captureArenaTrace: startTime is not a date-time: ${options.startTime}`);\n  }\n\n  const replay = game.getReplayRecord();\n  const initialState = game.getInitialState();\n  const seed = typeof initialState.seed === \"number\" ? initialState.seed : 0;\n\n  // Caller-supplied journals keep their own timestamps; only the engine's are\n  // ours to re-derive.\n  const recorded = options.events\n    ? [...options.events]\n    : game.getRecordedEvents().map((event) =>\n        startMs === undefined\n          ? event\n          : { ...event, timestamp: new Date(startMs + event.tick * TICK_MS).toISOString() },\n      );\n  const merged = [\n    ...recorded,\n    ...(options.additionalEvents ?? []).map((event) => ({ ...event, round: roundForTick(event.tick) })),\n  ];\n  // Stable by tick: a caller-supplied note lands beside the turn it is about\n  // rather than after the shift outcome.\n  const events = merged\n    .map((event, index) => ({ event, index }))\n    .sort((a, b) => a.event.tick - b.event.tick || a.index - b.index)\n    .map(({ event }) => event);\n\n  return {\n    version: TRACE_V3_VERSION,\n    episodeId: options.episodeId ?? `${replay.variation}-${seed}`,\n    ...(options.sessionId === undefined ? {} : { sessionId: options.sessionId }),\n    seed,\n    envVersion: options.envVersion ?? ARENA_ENV_VERSION,\n    contractVersion: TRACE_V3_CONTRACT_VERSION,\n    runKind: options.runKind,\n    initialState,\n    events,\n    replay,\n    terminal: game.getTerminalStatus(),\n    deletion: {\n      requestId: options.deletion?.requestId ?? null,\n      status: options.deletion?.status ?? \"retained\",\n    },\n  };\n}\n\n// ── Export ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────\n\n/** The whole record as one pretty-printed JSON document. */\nexport function exportTraceJson(trace: RestaurantArenaTraceV3): /** One entry per offending field, prefixed with its dotted path. */\n  errors: string[];\n}\n\ntype Errors = string[];\n\nconst isRecord = (value: unknown): value is Record<string, unknown> =>\n  typeof value === \"object\" && value !== null && !Array.isArray(value);\n\nfunction shape(\n  errors: Errors,\n  path: string,\n  value: unknown,\n  required: readonly string[],\n  allowed: readonly Omitted from the record when absent. */\n  sessionId?: string;\n  /** Required: live gameplay, synthetic episodes and benchmark episodes must stay distinguishable. */\n  runKind: TraceRunKind;\n  envVersion?: string;\n  /**\n   * Wall clock for tick 0. Given, the run's own recorded events are re-stamped\n   * from it (`startTime + tick * 3000ms`, the engine's rule) so a captured\n   * trace is byte-reproducible — which is what lets the benchmark fixture be\n   * diffed against a fresh capture at all.\n   */\n  startTime?: string;\n  deletion?: Partial<TraceV3Deletion>;\n  /** Omit to capture the run's own recorded event journal; pass to replace it wholesale. */\n  events?: TraceV3Event[];\n  /**\n   * Events the caller wants merged into the captured journal alongside the\n   * game's own recorded events (e.g. an out-of-band player note). Each is\n   * stamped with the `round` its `tick` falls in via `roundForTick`, and the\n   * merged journal stays ordered by tick.\n   */\n  additionalEvents?: TraceV3Event[];\n}\n\n/**\n * Turn a running game into a complete restaurant-arena-trace-v3 record.\n *\n * The instance method `game.captureTrace(options)` delegates here; both are\n * supported entry points because the overlay calls this standalone form.\n */\nexport function captureArenaTrace(game: RestaurantGame, options: TraceCaptureOptions): RestaurantArenaTraceV3 {\n  if (!options || !TRACE_RUN_KINDS.includes(options.runKind)) {\n    throw new TypeError(`captureArenaTrace: runKind must be one of ${TRACE_RUN_KINDS.join(\", \")}`);\n  }\n  const startMs = options.startTime === undefined ? undefined : Date.parse(options.startTime);\n  if (startMs !== undefined && Number.isNaN(startMs)) {\n    throw new TypeError(`captureArenaTrace: startTime is not a date-time: ${options.startTime}`);\n  }\n\n  const replay = game.getReplayRecord();\n  const initialState = game.getInitialState();\n  const seed = typeof initialState.seed === \"number\" ? initialState.seed : 0;\n\n  // Caller-supplied journals keep their own timestamps; only the engine's are\n  // ours to re-derive.\n  const recorded = options.events\n    ? [...options.events]\n    : game.getRecordedEvents().map((event) =>\n        startMs === undefined\n          ? event\n          : { ...event, timestamp: new Date(startMs + event.tick * TICK_MS).toISOString() },\n      );\n  const merged = [\n    ...recorded,\n    ...(options.additionalEvents ?? []).map((event) => ({ ...event, round: roundForTick(event.tick) })),\n  ];\n  // Stable by tick: a caller-supplied note lands beside the turn it is about\n  // rather than after the shift outcome.\n  const events = merged\n    .map((event, index) => ({ event, index }))\n    .sort((a, b) => a.event.tick - b.event.tick || a.index - b.index)\n    .map(({ event }) => event);\n\n  return {\n    version: TRACE_V3_VERSION,\n    episodeId: options.episodeId ?? `${replay.variation}-${seed}`,\n    ...(options.sessionId === undefined ? {} : { sessionId: options.sessionId }),\n    seed,\n    envVersion: options.envVersion ?? ARENA_ENV_VERSION,\n    contractVersion: TRACE_V3_CONTRACT_VERSION,\n    runKind: options.runKind,\n    initialState,\n    events,\n    replay,\n    terminal: game.getTerminalStatus(),\n    deletion: {\n      requestId: options.deletion?.requestId ?? null,\n      status: options.deletion?.status ?? \"retained\",\n    },\n  };\n}\n\n// ── Export ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────\n\n/** The whole record as one pretty-printed JSON document. */\nexport function exportTraceJson(trace: RestaurantArenaTraceV3): IDEMPOTENCY_KEY = /^[A-Za-z0-9][A-Za-z0-9._:-]{0,129}$/;\nconst STATE_HASH = /^sha256:[0-9a-f]{64}$/;\nconst DATE_TIME = /^\\d{4}-\\d{2}-\\d{2}[Tt]\\d{2}:\\d{2}:\\d{2}(\\.\\d+)?([Zz]|[+-]\\d{2}:\\d{2})$/;\n\nconst TRACE_EVENT_KINDS: readonly TraceEventKind[] = [\n  \"observation\", \"action\", \"player_correction\", /** One entry per offending field, prefixed with its dotted path. */\n  errors: string[];\n}\n\ntype Errors = string[];\n\nconst isRecord = (value: unknown): value is Record<string, unknown> =>\n  typeof value === \"object\" && value !== null && !Array.isArray(value);\n\nfunction shape(\n  errors: Errors,\n  path: string,\n  value: unknown,\n  required: readonly string[],\n  allowed: readonly path: string, value: unknown, min?: number, max?: number): void {\n  if (value === undefined) return;\n  if (typeof value !== \"number\" || !Number.isFinite(value)) errors.push(`${path}: must be a path: string, value: unknown, item: (path: string, entry: unknown) => void): void {\n  if (value === undefined) return;\n  if (!Array.isArray(value)) {\n    errors.push(`${path}: must be an array`);\n    return;\n  }\n  value.forEach((entry, index) => item(`${path}[${index}]`, entry));\n}\n\nfunction validateInitialState(errors: Errors, path: string, value: unknown): void {\n  const state = `${path}.outcomes.completed`, outcomes.completed, 0);\n    integer(errors, `${path}.outcomes.safeOrders`, outcomes.safeOrders, 0);\n    numeric(errors, `${path}.outcomes.coordination`, outcomes.coordination, 0, 1);\n    numeric(errors, `${path}.outcomes.correctionUptake`, outcomes.correctionUptake, 0, 1);\n  }\n}\n\nfunction validateToolResult(errors: Errors, path: string, value: unknown): void {\n  if (value === undefined || value === null) return;\n  if (!isRecord(value)) {\n    errors.push(`${path}: must be an object or null`);\n    return;\n  }\n  if (value.ok !== undefined && typeof value.ok !== \"boolean\") errors.push(`${path}.ok: must be a boolean`);\n  numeric(errors, `${path}.latencyMs`, value.latencyMs, 0);\n  const error = value.error;\n  if (error !== errors.push(`${path}.error.message: is required`);\n      if (error.retryable !== undefined && typeof error.retryable !== \"boolean\") {\n        errors.push(`${path}.error.retryable: must be a (value.ok === false && !isRecord(error)) errors.push(`${path}.error: is required when ok is false`);\n  if (isRecord(error) && value.ok !== false) errors.push(`${path}.ok: must be false when an error body is present`);\n}\n\nconst EVENT_FIELDS = [\n  \"tick\", \"round\", \"kind\", \"timestamp\", \"stateHash\", \"actorId\", \"role\", \"targetRole\",\n  \"checkpointId\", \"model\", \"requestId\", \"idempotencyKey\", \"text\", \"observation\", \"action\",\n  \"toolResult\", \"outcome\", \"correctionRationale\", \"correctionCategory\",\n  \"changedDecisionEventId\", \"probeEventId\", \"subject\", \"payload\",\n] as const;\n\nfunction validateEvent(errors: Errors, path: string, value: unknown): void {\n  const event = shape(errors, path, value, [\"tick\", \"kind\", \"timestamp\", id\");\n  matches(errors, `${path}.idempotencyKey`, event.idempotencyKey, IDEMPOTENCY_KEY, \"an idempotency key\");\n  nullableText(errors, `${path}.text`, event.text);\n  nullableObject(errors, oneOf(errors, `${path}.subject.kind`, subject.kind, [\"order\", \"ingredient\", \"equipment\", \"handoff\"]);\n      matches(errors, `${path}.subject.id`, subject.id, ARENA_ID, \"an arena id\");\n    }\n  }\n  nullableObject(errors, `${path}.payload`, event.payload);\n}\n\nfunction validateEnvelope(errors: Errors, path: string, value: unknown): void {\n  const envelope = shape(\n    errors,\n    path,\n    value,\n    [\"version\", \"episodeId\", \"actorId\", \"actorType\", \"role\", \"tool\", \"arguments\", \"tick\", \"timestamp\", \"requestId\", \"idempotencyKey\"],\n    [\"version\", \"episodeId\", \"actorId\", \"actorType\", \"role\", \"tool\", \"arguments\", \"tick\", \"timestamp\", \"requestId\", \"idempotencyKey\"],\n  );\n  if (!envelope) return;\n  constant(errors, envelope.actorId, ARENA_ID, \"an arena id\");\n  oneOf(errors, `${path}.actorType`, envelope.actorType, [\"worker\", \"player\"]);\n  oneOf(errors, `${path}.role`, envelope.role, TRACE_V3_ROLES);\n  oneOf(errors, `${path}.tool`, envelope.tool, ACTION_TOOLS);\n  if (envelope.arguments !== undefined && !isRecord(envelope.arguments)) errors.push(`${path}.arguments: must be an object`);\n  integer(errors, `${path}.tick`, envelope.tick, 0);\n  matches(errors, `${path}.timestamp`, envelope.timestamp, DATE_TIME, \"an RFC 3339 date-time\");\n  matches(errors, `${path}.requestId`, envelope.requestId, ARENA_ID, \"an arena id\");\n  matches(errors, `${path}.idempotencyKey`, envelope.idempotencyKey, IDEMPOTENCY_KEY, \"an idempotency key\");\n}\n\nfunction validateReplayInput(errors: Errors, path: string, value: unknown): void {\n  if (!isRecord(value)) {\n    errors.push(`${path}: must be an object`);\n    return;\n  }\n  const base = [\"kind\", \"tick\", \"stateHash\", \"restaurantStateHash\"];\n  const kind = value.kind;\n  const allowed =\n    kind === \"step\" ? [...base, \"action\"]\n    : kind === \"envelope\" ? [...base, \"envelope\", \"telemetry\"]\n    : kind === \"controllers\" ? [...base, \"roles\"]\n    : base;\n  if (kind !== \"step\" && kind !== \"time\" && kind !== \"envelope\" && kind !== \"controllers\") {\n    errors.push(`${path}.kind: must be one of \"step\", \"time\", \"envelope\", \"controllers\"`);\n    return;\n  }\n  const input = shape(errors, path, value, [\"kind\", \"tick\", \"stateHash\"], allowed);\n  if (!input) return;\n  integer(errors, `${path}.tick`, input.tick, 0);\n  matches(errors, `${path}.stateHash`, input.stateHash, STATE_HASH, \"a sha256:<64 hex> digest\");\n  matches(errors, `${path}.restaurantStateHash`, input.restaurantStateHash, STATE_HASH, \"a sha256:<64 hex> digest\");\n  if (kind === \"step\") {\n    if (input.action === undefined) errors.push(`${path}.action: is required`);\n    else text(errors, `${path}.action`, input.action);\n  }\n  if (kind === \"envelope\") {\n    if (input.envelope === undefined) errors.push(`${path}.envelope: is required`);\n    else validateEnvelope(errors, `${path}.envelope`, input.envelope);\n    if (input.telemetry !== undefined && !isRecord(input.telemetry)) errors.push(`${path}.telemetry: must be an object`);\n  }\n  if (kind === \"controllers\") {\n    if (input.roles === undefined) errors.push(`${path}.roles: is required`);\n    else {\n      each(errors, `${path}.roles`, input.roles, (rolePath, role) => oneOf(errors, rolePath, role, TRACE_V3_ROLES));\n      if (Array.isArray(input.roles) && new Set(input.roles).size !== input.roles.length) {\n        errors.push(`${path}.roles: must not repeat a role`);\n      }\n    }\n  }\n}\n\n/**\n * Check a decoded record against `contracts/restaurant-arena-trace-v3.schema.json`\n * field by field. Every offending field gets its own error, so a rejection says\n * what is wrong rather than only that something is.\n */\nexport function validateArenaTraceV3(value: unknown): TraceValidationResult 0; j < 16; j++) {\n      w[j] = view.getUint32(i + j * 4, false);\n    }\n    for (let j = 16; j < 64; j++) {\n      const w15 = w[j - 15]!;\n      const w2 = w[j - 2]!;\n      const s0 =\n        ((w15 >>> 7) | (w15 << 25)) ^\n        ((w15 >>> 18) | (w15 << 14)) ^\n        (w15 >>> 3);\n      const s1 =\n        ((w2 >>> 17) | (w2 << 15)) ^\n        ((w2 >>> 19) | (w2 << 13)) ^\n        (w2 >>> 10);\n      w[j] = (w[j - 16]! + s0 + w[j - 7]! + s1) >>> 0;\n    }\n\n    let a = h0, b = h1, c = h2, d = h3, e = h4, f = h5, g = h6, h = h7;\n\n    for (let j = 0; j < 64; j++) {\n      const s1 = ((e >>> 6) | (e << 26)) ^ ((e >>> 11) | (e << 21)) ^ ((e >>> 25) | (e << 7));\n      const ch = (e & f) ^ (~e & g);\n      const temp1 = (h + s1 + ch + K[j]! + w[j]!) >>> 0;\n      const s0 = ((a >>> 2) | (a << 30)) ^ ((a >>> 13) | (a << 19)) ^ ((a >>> 22) | (a << 10));\n      const maj = (a & b) ^ (a & c) ^ (b & c);\n      const temp2 = (s0 + maj) >>> 0;\n\n      h = g;\n      g = f;\n      f = e;\n      e = (d + temp1) >>> 0;\n      d = c;\n      c = b;\n      b = a;\n      a = (temp1 + temp2) >>> 0;\n    }\n\n    h0 = (h0 + a) >>> 0;\n    h1 = (h1 + b) >>> 0;\n    h2 = (h2 + c) >>> 0;\n    h3 = (h3 + d) >>> 0;\n    h4 = (h4 + e) >>> 0;\n    h5 = (h5 + f) >>> 0;\n    h6 = (h6 + g) >>> 0;\n    h7 = (h7 + h) >>> 0;\n  }\n\n  const hex = [h0, h1, h2, h3, h4, h5, h6, h7]\n    .map((v) => (v >>> 0).toString(16).padStart(8, \"0\"))\n    .join(\"\");\n  return `sha256:${hex}`;\n}\n\nconst FLOAT_FIELDS = new Set([\n  \"cash\", \"coordination\", \"correctionUptake\", \"load\", \"reading\",\n  \"reputation\", \"safetyThreshold\", \"satisfaction\", \"waitTime\", \"waste\",\n]);\n\nfunction serializeJson(value: unknown, pretty: boolean, sortKeys: boolean, level = 0, key?: string): string | undefined {\n  if (value === undefined) return undefined;\n  if (value === null || typeof value === \"boolean\" || typeof value === \"string\") return JSON.stringify(value);\n  if (typeof value === \"number\") {\n    if (!Number.isFinite(value)) throw new TypeError(\"canonical JSON does not support non-finite numbers\");\n    return FLOAT_FIELDS.has(key ?? \"\") && Number.isInteger(value) ? `${value}.0` : JSON.stringify(value);\n  }\n  if (Array.isArray(value)) {\n    const items = value.map((item) => serializeJson(item, pretty, sortKeys, level + 1));\n    return pretty && items.length > 0\n      ? `[\\n${items.map((item) => `${\"  \".repeat(level + 1)}${item ?? \"null\"}`).join(\",\\n\")}\\n${\"  \".repeat(level)}]`\n      : `[${items.map((item) => item ?? \"null\").join(\",\")}]`;\n  }\n  if (typeof value === \"object\") {\n    const record = value as Record<string, unknown>;\n    const keys = Object.keys(record);\n    if (sortKeys) keys.sort();\n    const entries = keys.flatMap((entryKey) => {\n      const serialized = serializeJson(record[entryKey], pretty, sortKeys, level + 1, entryKey);\n      return serialized === undefined ? [] : [[entryKey, serialized] as const];\n    });\n    return pretty && entries.length > 0\n      ? `{\\n${entries.map(([entryKey, serialized]) => `${\"  \".repeat(level + 1)}${JSON.stringify(entryKey)}: ${serialized}`).join(\",\\n\")}\\n${\"  \".repeat(level)}}`\n      : `{${entries.map(([entryKey, serialized]) => `${JSON.stringify(entryKey)}:${serialized}`).join(\",\")}}`;\n  }\n  throw new TypeError(`Unsupported JSON value: ${typeof value}`);\n}\n\n/** Backend-compatible JSON: sorted keys and decimal spelling for float fields. */\nexport function canonicalJson(value: unknown): string {\n  return serializeJson(value, false, true) ?? \"null\";\n}\n\n/**\n * Readable JSON that still spells float fields with a decimal point, so an\n * exported document round-trips through a typed backend reader unchanged. Keys\n * stay in declaration order — this is for humans and diffs, not for hashing.\n */\nexport function prettyJson(value: unknown): string {\n  return serializeJson(value, true, false) ?? \"null\";\n}\n\nexport function computeStateHash(data: unknown): string {\n  const json = typeof data === \"string\" ? data : canonicalJson(data);\n  return sha256Bytes(new TextEncoder().encode(json));\n}\n\n// ── Capture ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────\n\n/** One simulation tick of wall clock, matching the engine's own event stamping. */\nconst TICK_MS = 3000;\n\nexport const TRACE_RUN_KINDS = [\"live\", \"synthetic\", \"benchmark\"] as const;\nexport type TraceRunKind = (typeof TRACE_RUN_KINDS)[number];\n\nexport interface TraceCaptureOptions {\n  /** Defaults to `<variation>-<seed>`: the scenario, which repeats across runs. */\n  episodeId?: string;\n  /** The one run this trace came from. Omitted from the record when absent. */\n  sessionId?: string;\n  /** Required: live gameplay, synthetic episodes and benchmark episodes must stay distinguishable. */\n  runKind: TraceRunKind;\n  envVersion?: string;\n  /**\n   * Wall clock for tick 0. Given, the run's own recorded events are re-stamped\n   * from it (`startTime + tick * 3000ms`, the engine's rule) so a captured\n   * trace is byte-reproducible — which is what lets the benchmark fixture be\n   * diffed against a fresh capture at all.\n   */\n  startTime?: string;\n  deletion?: Partial<TraceV3Deletion>;\n  /** Omit to capture the run's own recorded event journal; pass to replace it wholesale. */\n  events?: TraceV3Event[];\n  /**\n   * Events the caller wants merged into the captured journal alongside the\n   * game's own recorded events (e.g. an out-of-band player note). Each is\n   * stamped with the `round` its `tick` falls in via `roundForTick`, and the\n   * merged journal stays ordered by tick.\n   */\n  additionalEvents?: TraceV3Event[];\n}\n\n/**\n * Turn a running game into a complete restaurant-arena-trace-v3 record.\n *\n * The instance method `game.captureTrace(options)` delegates here; both are\n * supported entry points because the overlay calls this standalone form.\n */\nexport function captureArenaTrace(game: RestaurantGame, options: TraceCaptureOptions): RestaurantArenaTraceV3 {\n  if (!options || !TRACE_RUN_KINDS.includes(options.runKind)) {\n    throw new TypeError(`captureArenaTrace: runKind must be one of ${TRACE_RUN_KINDS.join(\", \")}`);\n  }\n  const startMs = options.startTime === undefined ? undefined : Date.parse(options.startTime);\n  if (startMs !== undefined && Number.isNaN(startMs)) {\n    throw new TypeError(`captureArenaTrace: startTime is not a date-time: ${options.startTime}`);\n  }\n\n  const replay = game.getReplayRecord();\n  const initialState = game.getInitialState();\n  const seed = typeof initialState.seed === \"number\" ? initialState.seed : 0;\n\n  // Caller-supplied journals keep their own timestamps; only the engine's are\n  // ours to re-derive.\n  const recorded = options.events\n    ? [...options.events]\n    : game.getRecordedEvents().map((event) =>\n        startMs === undefined\n          ? event\n          : { ...event, timestamp: new Date(startMs + event.tick * TICK_MS).toISOString() },\n      );\n  const merged = [\n    ...recorded,\n    ...(options.additionalEvents ?? []).map((event) => ({ ...event, round: roundForTick(event.tick) })),\n  ];\n  // Stable by tick: a caller-supplied note lands beside the turn it is about\n  // rather than after the shift outcome.\n  const events = merged\n    .map((event, index) => ({ event, index }))\n    .sort((a, b) => a.event.tick - b.event.tick || a.index - b.index)\n    .map(({ event }) => event);\n\n  return {\n    version: TRACE_V3_VERSION,\n    episodeId: options.episodeId ?? `${replay.variation}-${seed}`,\n    ...(options.sessionId === undefined ? {} : { sessionId: options.sessionId }),\n    seed,\n    envVersion: options.envVersion ?? ARENA_ENV_VERSION,\n    contractVersion: TRACE_V3_CONTRACT_VERSION,\n    runKind: options.runKind,\n    initialState,\n    events,\n    replay,\n    terminal: game.getTerminalStatus(),\n    deletion: {\n      requestId: options.deletion?.requestId ?? null,\n      status: options.deletion?.status ?? \"retained\",\n    },\n  };\n}\n\n// ── Export ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────\n\n/** The whole record as one pretty-printed JSON document. */\nexport function exportTraceJson(trace: RestaurantArenaTraceV3): string {\n  return prettyJson(trace);\n}\n\n/**\n * Streaming form: a header line carrying everything but the journal, then one\n * line per event. `scripts/validate-arena-trace.py` reassembles it the /^\\d{4}-\\d{2}-\\d{2}[Tt]\\d{2}:\\d{2}:\\d{2}(\\.\\d+)?([Zz]|[+-]\\d{2}:\\d{2})$/;\n\nconst TRACE_EVENT_KINDS: readonly TraceEventKind[] = [\n  \"observation\", \"action\", \"player_correction\", /** One entry per offending field, prefixed with its dotted path. */\n  errors: string[];\n}\n\ntype Errors = string[];\n\nconst isRecord = (value: unknown): value is Record<string, unknown> =>\n  typeof value === \"object\" && value !== null && !Array.isArray(value);\n\nfunction shape(\n  errors: Errors,\n  path: string,\n  value: unknown,\n  required: readonly string[],\n  allowed: readonly string[],\n): Record<string, unknown> | undefined {\n  if (!isRecord(value)) {\n    errors.push(`${path}: must be an object`);\n    return undefined;\n  }\n  for (const key of required) {\n    if field`);\n  }\n  return value;\n}\n\nfunction constant(errors: Errors, path: string, value: unknown, expected: string): void {\n  if (value !== undefined && value !== expected) errors.push(`${path}: }\n}\n\nfunction text(errors: Errors, path: string, value: unknown, nullable = false): void {\n  if (value === undefined || (nullable && value === null)) return;\n  if (typeof value !== \"string\" ||
